summary: Iteration 77 frontend-only test. Verified (A) Blog nav link added between Sustainability and Find Retailers in shared Header (renders on home, /sustainability, /our-story). (B) CSR Environmental Conservation badge now reads live tree count from /api/impact/trees and matches TreeCounter widget. Both showed 39 == 39 == API value with zero drift. Hard-coded '50+ trees planted' string is gone. Other three CSR badges (Cleaner burning, 7 families supported, 12 student years funded) unchanged.
action_items: ENV/INFRA (not code): The preview URL https://fragrance-rewards.preview.emergentagent.com/api/impact/trees currently returns 404 (routing/ingress does not appear to be forwarding /api to backend). With NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL pointing there, the client-side fetch in TreeCounter.js and CSRSection.js returns nothing, so in production preview the TreeCounter is hidden and the CSR badge falls back to 'Growing every day'. Locally verified end-to-end by pointing NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL='' (relative -> Next rewrites -> localhost:8001) — both numbers correctly render 39. Recommend main agent verify ingress/rewrite setup for /api on the preview URL, OR set NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to '' so requests use the built-in Next rewrites.

PRE-EXISTING BUILD ERROR (unrelated to iter77): `yarn build` fails with 'You are attempting to export metadata from a component marked with use client' triggered via ./app/admin/b2b/preorders/page.js -> ./app/layout.js chain. supervisor 'frontend' service is FATAL because there is no .next production build. Testing was done via `yarn dev` instead. Main agent should investigate the metadata/use-client conflict in the admin route chain.
critical_code_review_comments: CSRSection.js and TreeCounter.js both independently call /api/impact/trees (two round-trips). Consider lifting the fetch to a shared context/provider or pass liveTrees from parent to TreeCounter to guarantee single source of truth in a single fetch. Current code guarantees value consistency only because backend response is stable within a page load; two separate fetches could theoretically diverge if backend rate changed between calls.
CSRSection uses `key={index}` in .map — fine here (static list) but discouraged; consider stable keys.
Header nav 'Contact' item is a scroll anchor '#contact' but there is no /contact route; if a user opens /contact directly they hit 404 (not a regression from this iteration).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the two changes under test

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend supervisor is FATAL (no .next build) due to a pre-existing metadata/use-client conflict. Use `yarn dev` in /app/frontend-next for manual testing. Preview URL's /api routing is broken (404) — for accurate client-side integration testing, temporarily set NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL='' in /app/frontend-next/.env.local and restart, so fetches go through Next rewrites to localhost:8001. Backend /api/impact/trees currently returns 39.
rca of the issue: Original bug (badge said '50+ trees planted' while pill said 39) was a hard-coded string in the csrInitiatives array. Fix moves the impact string of the 'trees' initiative to be derived from state populated by fetching /api/impact/trees inside CSRSection.js useEffect, with a safe non-numeric fallback ('Growing every day'). Verified with browser automation: DOM contained two occurrences of '39 trees planted' and zero occurrences of '50+ trees planted'.
